verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Python/TypeScript SDKs, a REST API, and an MCP server for AI clients such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and Windsurf. None of it shows documented adapters for agent frameworks like the Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain or CrewAI. The MCP server and general SDKs belong to separate stories and are building blocks, not framework adapters, so they earn no credit here.
